a_node_is_not_covered_because_one_ucc_ma: Recreation carries one canonical UCC and ninety-one omitted published UCCs worth 489,524 million dollars for All Consumer Units. Calling it covered would be false.

additivity_validation.bound_is_derived_not_tuned: BLS publishes these aggregates rounded to whole millions, so each figure carries at most half a unit of error. A double count of even the smallest leaf exceeds the bound by orders of magnitude.
additivity_validation.domain_test: sum of a domain's numeric leaves against its published domain-root aggregate
additivity_validation.grand_total_test: sum of the fourteen domain roots against published TOTALEXP, which catches a domain that is itself a child of another
additivity_validation.on_failure: If any domain or the grand total fails, no expenditure ratio is produced and full_universe_coverage_status is BLOCKED. Structural UCC counts are still reported, because counting needs no additivity.
additivity_validation.why_required: Milestone 1 established empirically that numeric UCCs behave as leaves, on four domains. That result does not transfer to ten domains nobody has checked, and summing a nested code would inflate the denominator silently.

candidate_node_attribution.purpose: so omitted expenditure can be reported by DMI node
candidate_node_attribution.warning: A candidate node is not a mapping decision. Reading it as one would adjudicate 244 UCCs that have had no mapping, provenance or scope work done on them.

concordance_is_not_exclusion_evidence: Absence from the 2024 CE-to-CPI concordance is recorded on every omitted row as a fact and is never used as the reason for omission. Milestone 2 established that a UCC missing from the concordance is not thereby out of CPI scope, and re-importing that inference here would adjudicate by accident.

coverage_layers.consumption_variant: the same ratio against a denominator excluding CASHCONT and INSPENSN. Both are reported. Choosing between them is a scope judgement C3 does not make.
coverage_layers.never_conflated: UCC coverage and expenditure coverage are separate quantities and are never substituted for one another.
coverage_layers.published_expenditure_coverage: canonical source expenditure / universe expenditure, by population
coverage_layers.structural_ucc_coverage: canonical published UCC count / universe UCC count; a count diagnostic only

milestone: Detailed Inflation Substrate v0.1, task C3-B

nonconsumption_domains.treatment: Labelled, not removed. Cash contributions are transfers and personal insurance and pensions are saving and risk transfer; both are inside CE total expenditures and outside household consumption. Removing them silently would be a scope adjudication.

scope: Research only. Declares how the published expenditure universe is constructed and how coverage of it is measured. It adjudicates no UCC, assigns no Track-A treatment and selects no normalisation denominator.

inclusion_exclusion: Excluded: non-numeric item codes, which are published roll-ups of the numeric leaves.
Excluded: the ADDENDA, INCOME and CUCHARS categories, which are not expenditure.
Excluded: series not active in 2024. This is why 581 of the 998 numeric codes in cx.item are in the universe and 417 are not.
TOTALEXP is the published grand-total root. It is the parent in the additivity check and never a domain.
universe_construction_rule.no_hand_entered_lists: No UCC list appears in the coverage module. Membership is a consequence of the predicate, so a UCC cannot be added or dropped by editing code.
universe_construction_rule.predicate: category_code == EXPEND and demographics_code == LB01 and characteristics_code in the six Income-Quintile populations and begin_year <= 2024 <= end_year and item_code matches ^[0-9]{6}$

verdict_rule.default: MATERIAL_EXPANSION_REQUIRED when material expenditure domains have not had the mapping and scope discipline the audited domains received, unless the evidence strongly supports otherwise.
verdict_rule.not_a_percentage_threshold: No percentage decides the verdict. The diagnostics are reported and the recommendation is reasoned.
